label: copy-phase fed-back u when the next output is o (u-o bigram recall)
explanation: Copy-phase only (never original or delimiter steps). 94% of activations and 97% of mass are at steps where the fed-back input is u (the rest is mostly fed-back o). The strongest activations come when the u is about to be followed by o, i.e. the original sequence had the bigram u o at position 2 or later (recall_idx >= 3). That core predicate has about 96% precision and about 68% of mass on dev. Never fires at recall_idx 0-1 and is weak when the u came from original position 1. Weak activations (bottom two quartiles) are on fed-back u followed by other tokens (p, u, etc.). Input u alone is far too broad (7% precision), so recall of the weak tail is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=u (+7.47), in_tok=u (+4.52), next_out=o (+4.09), phase=2 & out_tok=o (+3.88), phase=2 & in_tok=o (+3.82), out_tok=o (+3.60). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.50), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.54), recall_idx=1 (-3.54), out_tok=1 (-2.89).
